name: Teikoku no Isan
source:
When the king died, the kingdom's army rebelled.
The young new prince Torias fled, leaving his younger sisters and mother behind.
"What shall we do with these young ladies?" sneered the general's men.

Now Torias accepts a massive responsibility. Take back the kingdom and your family!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ085951.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
